skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.ma: How far to look for a player under the crosshair (own local raycast, not limited by reach).
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.lo: A locked target is released when it gets farther than this (never less than Max distance), is removed, dies, or when you press the key again.
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.li: How long the panel stays after the crosshair leaves the player (without a lock).
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.hi: Enlarges player hitboxes for the inspector's own raycast, so aiming at range is easier.
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.sh: Main hand and off hand rows below the armor.
Empty slots read "no data": nothing is equipped there, or the server does not send that slot.
Show a "no data" line for enchantable items without received enchantments (unenchanted or hidden by the server; the client cannot tell).
Adds remaining/max after the percentage, e.g. 87% 316/363.
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.as: Vanilla does not send the damage value of an undamaged item, and servers that hide durability do not send it either. Off: such items show "no data". On: they show "100%?".
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.lo: Short action bar messages when a target is locked, unlocked or lost.
skirmish.gearinspector.slot.head: Head
skirmish.gearinspector.msg.no_target: GearInspector: no player under the crosshair (up to %s)
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.sh: Enchantments and durability listed under the target card
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.de: Compact: one line per item. On key: the full list while L-Alt is held.
Hold to expand the full list. The same key expands the events panel.
skirmish.module.gearinspector.setting.ho: Auto: on HolyWorld, show the donor armour tier (Griefer…Infinity), custom enchantments from the lore (Непробиваемый, Разрушитель, Критический…), enchantments above the vanilla maximum, the off-hand sphere or talisman and armour wear by Lite rules. Everything is read from items the client already has. Off: behave as on any server.

Lite Anarchy: the chance that armour loses no durability is 47 + 10 × Unbreaking level %. The estimate counts 1 durability point per hit; heavy hits, explosions and «Разрушитель» wear it faster. Prime uses the vanilla formula, so the estimate is off there.
skirmish.gearinspector.holy.hits_left: ≈ %s %s until it breaks (%s%% of hits cost nothing)
